messages:
kevin_csm: Quick heads up - Marigold Systems wants to spin up two new squads (support-ops + insights) and trial a live-docs summarization endpoint. They're asking for a pilot to cover both realtime and nightly embedding jobs. Renewal meets in ~8w, so this looks like an expansion opportunity but could be a renewal pivot if onboarding stalls. @aya_cs any notes from the kickoff? :mag:

aya_cs: They said current realtime QPS ~80, expecting up to 450 QPS across new squads during peak. Nightly embeddings: ~2.4M docs (avg 600 tokens each) processed in a 4-hour window. They prefer a short Dedicated pilot for SLA predictability. Concern: security team flagged PHI in a subset of docs. :warning:

rene_se: 450 QPS realtime is OK but we'll need to tune batching + low-latency kernel selection. For embeddings, 2.4M docs in 4h -> sustained throughput ~167k docs/hr. We should advise async batching + doc-chunking and KV prefix caching for repeated queries. Can they share a sample ingest CSV and a traffic histogram?

kevin_csm: Pasted the sample manifest ops sent in kickoff (from their infra):
```
embeddings_job:
  total_docs: 2400000
  avg_tokens: 600
  parallel_shards: 12
  concurrency_per_shard: 40
  window_hours: 4
```
aya_cs: They also want summarization with max latency 300ms p95 for short docs (~200 tokens). That's why they're leaning Dedicated.

tom_infra: Ops note - hosted concurrency default for embeddings is 25, KV retention short by default. With their requested concurrency we'd hit quota. I can allocate a temporary pilot pool, but legal needs NDA for PHI. Also need billing hold for the free pilot if approved. @billing_pm

billing_pm: We can do a 10-day pilot with billing hold. Need PO or approval email. Finance will require the pilot SOW link.

lina_legal: Legal: PHI = no hosted eval. We can support an isolated private eval (VPC) under our enterprise privacy addendum, but lead time ~3 weeks. If they need immediate pilot we can do a sanitized dataset on hosted or private temporary pool after NDA.

tom_infra: ops-bot: quota-check -> hosted-embeddings-concurrency=25, projected-need=480 => action_required: request infra increase or temp-pool. Recommend temp-pool + increase KV_cache_ttl to 48h for prefix reuse.

rene_se: Config wins: change vector dim to 1536, use quantized fp16 kernels for real-time path, chunk long docs to 256-token windows for embeddings. Expect ~25% cost reduction and better latency tail. I'll draft a config diff and a quick perf-run checklist.

kevin_csm: Proposed next steps I shared with account: 1) decide pilot modality (temp Dedicated pool vs. sanitized hosted) 2) sign NDA or PA 3) enablement session with SE + infra next Wed 4) share sample traffic + POC dataset. They asked for timeline today.

aya_cs: Customer is leaning to temp Dedicated pilot if we can start within 2 weeks. They're worried about renewal talk in 8 weeks. If we can show pilot metrics before renewal call it helps conversion.

billing_pm: I'll prep pilot SOW template and billing hold. Can @kevin_csm confirm SOW recipients? Also need internal signoff from PMs for 10-day free pilot.

kevin_csm: Confirmed recipients: marigold-devops@marigold.com and procurement@marigold.com. @rene_se can you attach the perf checklist? We'll need it for the enablement session.

deploybot: Deployment event: created-temp-pool/marigold-pilot by tom_infra at 1725559100 :rocket:

kevin_csm: OK team - treat as high-propensity expansion. Flagging renewal team and setting account-health to "expansion-eligible / renewal-at-risk" until legal/onboarding items clear. I'll post a 6-item onboarding checklist update by EOD. :clipboard>
